standard_doubt: '重提的过去实际数可选' with '可选 ... 留不留都不扣分' (D243 items 6, 6): it lets the extractor keep seven seven-month-old FY2026 lines (net income, current ratio, debt-to-equity, free cash flow) without any penalty; an analyst would call them noise that crowds the judge's view, and when the text dates them plainly ('In fiscal 2026, which ended in January 2026') they could be not kept.
